name: CopyCopy Ranking and Pipeline Evaluation Dataset
description: Synthetic fixtures for evaluating next-best-action ranking, learning from past actions, and pipeline follow-up suggestions.

cases.title: Terminal build error should prioritize explanation
cases.clipboard:
$ swift build
error: package 'MenuBarExtraAccess' requires macOS 14.0, but target 'CopyCopy' supports macOS 13.0
cases.rationale: A terminal error copied from Terminal usually needs explanation or cleanup, not translation or browser actions.

cases.title: Compact JSON should prioritize formatting
cases.rationale: Structured JSON has an obvious deterministic action before AI transforms.

cases.title: Code from IDE should prioritize code actions

cases.title: File path should prioritize Finder/Terminal actions
